message.content:
The magazine cover features a large white "TEMPO" masthead at the top. Below the title, an illustration depicts five men on a grassy hill against a blue and white cloudy sky. Four men wear green and brown camouflage uniforms and green caps; three are pushing upward on a large, oversized silver and white medical syringe that is angled diagonally. The syringe resembles a flagpole, and a small American flag is attached to its needle. A fifth man, wearing a white shirt and gray trousers, stands in front of the soldiers, pointing his right arm forward while looking ahead with an open-mouthed expression. A smaller, regular-sized syringe is stuck into the ground near the crouching soldier on the right.

Legible text includes "DI BALIK MERGER GOJEK DAN TOKOPEDIA" and "LIPUTAN KHUSUS HARI KARTINI" at the top. Near the flag, it says "50 Tahun!". Bold black text on the right reads "KOMPROMI VAKSIN TERAWAN" followed by several lines of smaller Indonesian text. At the bottom, a barcode, QR code, and publication details like "26 APRIL-2 MEI 2021" and "RP 45.000" are visible.
